shape: 2-portal corner arena (N + E gates joined at SE) with long west exploration chain
description: Two-portal stage where the north and east gates both wire directly into a single SE hub (pjdgdt) — N→E is just 2 hops. The rest of the room is a long branching exploration chain: a north column going up the east wall (v7ivdo → sa2gf0 → htynu8 SE pocket) and a long west chain across the south (1bnq73 → 5vwqpa → qxwqow → nm621e → yxe16d → j6zfos) for corner objectives.

portals.north: spawn_north at (14.01, -23.26) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, east column
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.07, -10.44) — gate on the east (high-X) side, north of midline

anchors.description: NE entry hub - joins both gates + north chain + west chain (matches pjdgdt)

traversalNotes: Direct N→E: spawn_north → ne_hub → spawn_east. 2 hops — the gates share a single SE hub.
STRICT-BACKBONE chains: the east column (e_col_mid → e_col_up → se_pocket) and the long west exploration (c_n_step → c_n_mid → nw_step → w_mid → w_up → nw_pocket) are single-file dead-ends.
ne_hub is the canonical 4-way dispatcher (both gates + both chains).
Two corner dead-ends: SE pocket (se_pocket, 3 hops from ne_hub) and NW pocket (nw_pocket, 6 hops from ne_hub).
